name: Unified Residence and Work Permit (Employee)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a valid employment contract with an Albanian employer; the unified permit's duration matches the contract term (typically 1-3 years).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer from an Albanian employer.

requirements.blocker_text: A Type D visa is normally required to enter and then apply for the residence permit in-country.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Type D visa via e-visa.al or an Albanian consulate.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of suitable accommodation in Albania.

evidence_required.document: Valid travel document with entry stamps

outcome.duration_length: Matches employment contract, typically 1-3 years; renewable

sources.title: Ministria e Brendshme (Ministry of Interior) -- Procedure and Documentation for Residence and Unified Permits: unified permit as employee (contract duration, 1-3 years), fees (8,000-10,000 ALL initial, 4,000 ALL renewal), process via e-Albania
Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs of Albania -- Type D visa: residency exceeding 90 days, allows in-country residence permit application

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). No distinct investor/business-owner or self-employment residence category was found at tier-1 precision during this research pass -- Albania appears to route business owners and self-employed foreigners through the same unified-permit framework tied to a registered economic activity (via the National Business Center) rather than a separately named, separately thresholded investor visa like several Caribbean/Gulf countries in this dataset. Not modeled as a separate route rather than guessed at a threshold. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are chained from al_permanent_residence (5yr, itself only secondary-sourced -- see that file's notes) plus al_naturalisation's 7-year standard bar counted from lawful residence generally, not from this specific permit -- flagged as an approximate inference, not a stated figure. mb.gov.al also confirms a distinct 'unique permit for domestic workers,' issued for the duration of employment -- not modeled as a separate file given the substantive overlap with this standard employee route.
